cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Efficiency Win
cards.instruction: Celebrate each inconvenience as proof that a faster, cheaper, or smarter routine can now be invented.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. The lift's broken. We can cancel the gym and use the stairs. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. A full programme included in the rent.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How do we carry the shopping?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Resistance training. We've saved two memberships.

mechanism: A confidently organizes life around a broken lift, celebrating each burden as exercise savings while conceding pace and load so B stays with the plan.
confusable: Unlike forced cheerfulness, every inconvenience creates a claimed cheaper routine; borrowed authority must materially adapt that routine to B participation.
comparison: Stairs and shopping as exercise differ from improvised edible serving bowls after dishwasher failure.
seedUse: Read protected D44-a single critically; use only lift/stairs/shopping mechanism as seed with S02-b adapting the activity to cooperation.
